constraints.name: ck_channel_action_state
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDENTE'::character varying, 'ENTREGUE'::character varying, 'EXECUTADA'::character varying, 'FALHOU'::character varying, 'FALHA_DEFINITIVA'::character varying, 'DESCARTADA'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_channel_action_type
constraints.definition: CHECK (((type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['MENSAGEM'::character varying, 'EDICAO'::character varying, 'DOCUMENTO'::character varying, 'RESPOSTA_CALLBACK'::character varying, 'MENSAGEM_ETAPA'::character varying])::text[])))
